sources.snippet: DeepInverse is an open-source PyTorch-based library for solving imaging inverse problems with deep learning. The library is part of the official PyTorch Ecosystem. deepinv accelerates deep learning research across imaging domains, enhances research reproducibility via a common modular framework of problems and algorithms, and lowers the entrance bar to new practitioners.
